provenance.source: Moved 2026-11-25 onto the COLORFUL kit picture (images/art/sega8/GameGearConsole.webp, 1295x750): it is the same photograph, so the old picture was registered onto the new one by edge correlation (scale 1.2000 x 1.1993, offset +7,-41 px, a sharp peak) and every box above was carried over by that map, sizes scaled with it; the boxes drawn over the new picture were checked by eye. The numbers below are the 1080x587 measurement they came from: measured 2026-11-20 on GameGearConsole.png (images/art/sega8, 1080x587) with the boxes drawn over a crop: d-pad centre (147,210), 124 px square; Start cap (884,121); button 1 (881,245), button 2 (956,193); hit circles 68 px (the cap plus a thumb), Start 52 px. Fractions of the WHOLE photograph: the host draws the body cut (play/cores/sega8/art.mjs GEOM gg: 49,36 978x533) and says so through setArtView (overlayView), as for the Lynx
